# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_goblin_corps.py" from goblin_data.py. Change the tables there and re-run.

# Plain ifs only: no else in these effects (Claude files/35).

# ---- The twists of the corps (province scope; marked lines of the floor tables, build_hold_exploration.py) ----
# An ore find: the Scavengers bring 1 Arcane Metal.
DA_GB_corps_ore = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_corps_run_scavengers }
		owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_arcane_metal_total value = 1 } }
	}
}
# A craft find: the Scavengers bring 1 Enchanted Building Materials, the Gizmo Hunters a Dwarven Prototype.
DA_GB_corps_lore = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_corps_run_scavengers }
		owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_enchanted_building_material_total value = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_flag = DA_GB_corps_run_gizmo }
		owner = { DA_GB_prototype = yes }
	}
}
# Deep goblins are kin to a goblin owner: the mark of the deep $n$ says so.
DA_GB_corps_kin_mark = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { DA_GB_corps_owner = yes } }
		clr_province_flag = DA_HX_m$n$_foe
		set_province_flag = DA_HX_m$n$_kin
	}
}
# A Dwarven Prototype (country scope): the running research jumps ahead, or innovativeness.
DA_GB_prototype = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_GB_research_running = yes }
		DA_GB_advance = { share = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_GB_research_running = yes } }
		change_innovativeness = 2
	}
}

# ---- Dwarven Technology (country scope): the reward of the repeatable tile ----
DA_PR_give.GB_dwarf = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_GB_dwarf_give_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_jury_rigging	# from now on every design takes every blueprint we know, jury-rigged off its path
		DA_GB_dwarven_blueprint = yes
		DA_GB_refresh = yes
	}
}
# One random dwarven blueprint of a power we have reached, by the dwarven pools of the hold exploration.
DA_GB_dwarven_blueprint = {
	random_list = {
		1 = {
			trigger = { DA_GB_dwarf_left.arcane = yes }
			capital_scope = { DA_Find_runic_blueprint = yes }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { DA_GB_dwarf_left.steam = yes DA_has_Steam_power_or_higher = yes }
			capital_scope = { DA_Find_steam_blueprint = yes }
		}
		1 = {
			trigger = { DA_GB_dwarf_left.electric = yes DA_has_Energy_power_or_higher = yes }
			capital_scope = { DA_Find_Runic_circuit_blueprint = yes }
		}
	}
}

# ---- The AI (country scope, on_yearly_pulse_4): a corps from one of its holds every five years ----
DA_GB_ai_corps = {
	if = {
		limit = { ai = yes DA_GB_corps_owner = yes NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes } OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_ai_corps } had_country_flag = { flag = DA_GB_ai_corps days = 1825 } } any_owned_province = { DA_GB_corps_can_go = yes } }
		random_owned_province = {
			limit = { DA_GB_corps_can_go = yes }
			clr_province_flag = DA_HX_corps_tunnelrats
			clr_province_flag = DA_HX_corps_blasters
			clr_province_flag = DA_HX_corps_gizmo
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { DA_completed.Explosive = yes } }
				random = {
					chance = 50
					set_province_flag = DA_HX_corps_blasters
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { DA_HX_corps_send_allowed = yes } }
				clr_province_flag = DA_HX_corps_blasters
			}
			if = {
				limit = { DA_HX_corps_send_allowed = yes }
				DA_HX_send_corps = yes
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = DA_GB_ai_corps
		set_country_flag = DA_GB_ai_corps
	}
}
